_comment: Random events (EventManager), on an outcome spectrum. An event square (and a few other things) rolls a tier from 'weights', shifted by who you are: the Cage and suspicion push it down, being last (in Dead Rats) pushes it up, leading pushes it down a little, late in the match it swings harder. A Lucky Tooth turns any bad, awful or catastrophic result into neutral. Then one event from that tier. 'do' is the effect; 'n' its size.

miracle.name: IT'S RAINING RATS
miracle.text: A Dead Rat drops out of the ceiling vent, into %s's lap.

miracle.name: A MIRACLE CURE
miracle.text: %s's wounds close up. Even the ones that shouldn't.

miracle.name: THE DEAD SIT UP
miracle.text: The lights fail. When they come back, there's a ghost back in a chair.

excellent.name: JACKPOT
excellent.text: The fruit machine in the corner pays out. Into %s's pocket.

excellent.name: SPECIAL DELIVERY
excellent.text: The Dead Rat is carried to the square just in front of %s.

excellent.name: AN UNUSUAL REWARD
excellent.text: There's a parcel with %s's name on it.

good.name: FREE SAMPLE
good.text: A tray goes by. %s takes something off it.

good.name: A GUARDIAN ANGEL
good.text: %s feels watched over. Something will take the next blow.

good.name: UNEXPECTED COOPERATION
good.text: Everyone pitches in. Everyone gets something.

good.name: A FOLLOWING WIND
good.text: The floor tilts. %s slides three squares on.

neutral.name: MUSICAL CHAIRS
neutral.text: The table turns. %s is somewhere else, and so is someone else.

neutral.name: FORCED TRADE
neutral.text: %s has to swap something with someone. No refunds.

neutral.name: A GAMBLING OPPORTUNITY
neutral.text: A man with no face offers %s a bet.

neutral.name: CALLER INTERVENTION
neutral.text: He takes a personal interest in %s.

neutral.name: AN EMERGENCY SURGICAL COMPETITION
neutral.text: A siren. Two operating tables are wheeled out. %s gets to watch, for now.

neutral.name: SPECIAL ATTRACTION
neutral.text: A bonus game is wheeled out for after the main event.

neutral.name: THE RAT MOVES
neutral.text: The Dead Rat has been moved. Nobody saw who by.

neutral.name: RENOVATIONS
neutral.text: A square near %s has been repainted.

bad.name: A SETBACK
bad.text: The floor tilts the other way. %s slides back three.

awful.name: THE RAT GETS UP
awful.text: One of %s's Dead Rats wasn't dead. It leaves.

catastrophe.name: THE BUTCHER'S HOUR
catastrophe.text: The butcher comes out of the kitchen for %s.

catastrophe.name: BANKRUPTCY
catastrophe.text: %s's Teeth are seized. Half of them.

catastrophe.name: VERMIN CONTROL
catastrophe.text: The exterminator takes two of %s's Dead Rats.
